title: BTS Complete Two Sold-Out Nights at Bogotá's El Campín
detail: October 3, 2026 — BTS played the second of two sold-out shows at Estadio El Campín in Bogotá, their first-ever concerts in Colombia and the opening stop of the ARIRANG World Tour's South American leg. Tour accounts put the crowd at roughly 53,000 per night, a figure that differs from the 35,000-45,000 reported by Colombian outlets for night one. The shows took place at 2,553 m elevation, and Colombian authorities projected more than $99 million in related tourism spending.

media.caption: BTS Bogotá shows fill El Campín.
